d:
Fresh off his televised victory on MTV Hustle 4.0, Siyaahi breaks his silence with an explosive new single, “First Day Out,” produced by long-time collaborator Acharya.
The track fuses drum & bass, afro-drill, and classic hip-hop energy—serving as both a war cry and a victory lap. The title isn't just clever—it's literal. Often referred to as a “creative prison,” MTV Hustle put many constraints on Siyaahi’s raw style and speed. This is his first release since stepping out of that zone—unfiltered, unbound, and fully in control.
Credits:
Written composed and performed by Siyaahi
